brief:
The Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem has established a priests council and advisory board, according to an announcement from the patriarchate dated September 2026. The formation also includes an episcopal council. The announcement was addressed to bishops, priests, and all believers in the patriarchate's jurisdiction.

Details regarding the specific composition, roles, and responsibilities of these bodies were not disclosed in the announcement.
